subject: Review: customer outage claim — no correlated platform evidence
messages:
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 13:55:00 -0700
From: Alex Ramos <alex@brightstripe.com>
To: support@redwood.ai
Subject: [BrightStripe] Intermittent 503s on /v1/generate around 13:40 PDT

Hi team,

We saw a spike of 503/timeout responses from Redwood around 13:40 PDT (see attached screenshot). The error rate for our endpoint rose to ~7% for ~3 minutes and then returned to normal. We pulled a small excerpt of our app logs and included a few request IDs: req_7a1b, req_7a1c, req_7a1f. Can you confirm if there was any platform-side outage or throttling?

Attaching: brightstripe_app_log_excerpt.txt (text), screenshot-error-20270729.png (image)

Thanks,
Alex Ramos
SRE Lead, BrightStripe
ops@brightstripe.com
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 14:03:00 -0700
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramos <alex@brightstripe.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: [BrightStripe] Intermittent 503s on /v1/generate around 13:40 PDT

Hi Alex — thanks for the quick report and the logs. I'm escalating this to our runtime team for correlation. Can you confirm: were the requests coming from a single IP range or multiple regions? Also, if you have any full request IDs beyond the snippet, please send them. We'll report back within 24 hours with what we find.

—Marissa
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 14:17:00 -0700
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Subject: Fwd: [BrightStripe] Intermittent 503s — initial signal

Marissa/Dylan — FYI forwarding BrightStripe's note. I pulled platform metrics for the window 13:30–13:45 PDT: no region-level outage, no capacity autoscaler events, no GPU node restarts in us-west-2. A handful of transient 503s at the edge (~0.02% globally) but nothing that lines up with a 7% spike for a single account.

Request IDs from Alex: req_7a1b, req_7a1c, req_7a1f (attached). If BrightStripe can share full request headers/trace IDs, we can try deeper path correlation.

—Sean
Support Engineer, Redwood Inference
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Fwd: [BrightStripe] Intermittent 503s — initial signal

I pulled the request-level logs we have for those time windows (edge + runtime). For req_7a1b/7a1c/7a1f I can only find partial traces on our edge proxies showing client connection timeouts and backend socket resets, but the runtime accepted the session and returned model responses in other correlated requests. No obvious model-side OOMs, retries, or throttling for BrightStripe's API key. No spike in latency distribution at the model pool level.

Hypothesis: client-side network/transit issue (connection resets) or upstream proxy in BrightStripe's stack. Recommend asking for a packet capture or full trace for one affected request.

—Dylan
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramos <alex@brightstripe.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: [BrightStripe] Intermittent 503s on /v1/generate around 13:40 PDT

Hi Alex — quick update from our runtime team: we reviewed edge proxy logs, autoscaler events, and node health for the 13:30–13:45 PDT window. We do not observe any platform-side incident that would explain a sustained 7% error rate for a single customer. The traces we can access show client-side connection resets.

Next steps we recommend: 1) capture a full request/response trace (including flow through your upstream proxy) for the next occurrence, 2) confirm whether BrightStripe's outgoing IP ranges were stable or if traffic was routed through a new NAT at that time, and 3) let us know if you see the spike again — we'll prioritize a joint live-debug session.

As a gesture, I'm proposing a one-off billing credit for the minute window you saw elevated errors while we continue to monitor. If you want to take that, I can open the billing request.

—Marissa
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 16:03:00 -0700
From: Alex Ramos <alex@brightstripe.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops+alerts@brightstripe.com
Subject: Re: [BrightStripe] Intermittent 503s on /v1/generate around 13:40 PDT

Thanks for digging in and the suggested next steps. We ran an internal packet capture and confirmed there were repeated TCP RSTs from an internal load-balancer that correlate with the timestamps you saw. No further spikes since then. We'll take you up on the credit request and file a joint postmortem if we see recurrence. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alex
SRE Lead, BrightStripe
